intent: Brokerage-grade price chart: precise, calm at rest, rich under the cursor. Hand-drawn SVG, responsive, keyboard accessible.

layout.card: bg #0b0b0c, border white/8%, radius 22px, inset top highlight, padding 20/28px
layout.header: identity + price + delta left; range segmented control right (full width on mobile)
layout.plot: ResizeObserver width; height 320px (230px < 520px); 56px right gutter for y labels (none on mobile); 40px volume band; 22px x-axis band
layout.footer: 4-col stat grid (2-col mobile) with 1px gaps: Open, High, Low, Volume

motion.rangeMorph: resample all series to 140 points; tween values 650ms ease-out quart
motion.figures: scrubbing is instant; range changes and pointer-leave count price, delta, percentage and stats to their new values over 450ms ease-out
motion.tooltip: date pill rises 4px and fades in over 160ms

responsive.mobile: range control full width; plot 72% height; no y gutter; 3 x labels; stats 2-up
responsive.desktop: y labels in gutter; 5 x labels; stats 4-up

accessibility: plot is focusable with role=img and a summary aria-label
ArrowLeft/Right inspect points, Shift for 10, Escape clears

content.name: Northwind Growth Index
content.data: { t: epoch ms, v: price, vol: volume }[] per range; demo data is a seeded random walk

avoid: default browser fonts in axis labels
